concerns.text: FR-001 requires the downloaded dataset to contain the exact columns laser power, scan speed, layer thickness, yield strength, and ductility. The plan substitutes a proxy dataset (RBF‑Morph “doe.csv”) that lacks these columns and treats its variables as placeholders. This constitutes a scope reduction that does not satisfy the functional requirement as written.

SC-004 expects the correlation between permutation‑importance rankings and a user‑provided (or literature) ranking of expected parameter influence. The plan instead computes correlation with a random baseline and notes it as a limitation, which does not meet the success criterion.
